description: This Java class defines the exception 'AclNotModifiableException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It indicates that the ACL of a Thing could not be modified due to missing permissions. The class includes static factory methods for creating instances from messages and JSON, as well as a builder class for constructing instances with customizable properties.

classes.name: AclNotModifiableException
classes.description: Final class representing an exception thrown when the ACL of a Thing cannot be modified due to permission issues. It includes static methods for creating instances from messages or JSON, and a builder for custom instantiation.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: Nested static class providing a fluent API for building 'AclNotModifiableException' instances with customizable message, description, cause, headers, and href.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for constructing a 'AclNotModifiableException' for a specific ThingId.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a provided message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception instance by parsing a JSON object and including specified headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
